outcome: Serum levels of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF)
Serum levels of tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha)
cohort: Pregnant women, including those with placenta previa and those without (controls)
finding: IL-10 levels were lower in patients with PAS compared to those with placenta previa alone, suggesting IL-10 may be a useful biomarker for differentiating between the two conditions.
